title: Neon Ballet Snow Globe
description: A surreal glowing snow globe sits on a wooden surface against a dark blue background. Inside the transparent sphere, three ballerinas in blue, pink, and white tutus strike elegant dance poses beneath a dripping neon tree with yellow, pink, and green branches, a crescent moon, and floating mushrooms, with colorful light streaks radiating outward.
